name: Pushyanth Damarapati
headline: Building AI systems you can inspect.
intro: Retrieval, document intelligence, machine learning, and agent systems. I build the infrastructure around models: evidence, evaluation, permissions, and recovery.
about: My projects explore what makes AI systems useful beyond a model response. That means tracing outputs to evidence, measuring quality before changing a pipeline, and giving people control over consequential actions.

projects.title: Document Intelligence Workbench
projects.description: A local invoice workspace that connects extracted fields to page evidence. Reviewers can correct a version, approve it, and export the exact approved record.
projects.detail: Built around human review, isolated parsing, auditable revisions, and recoverable processing. The project compares deterministic extraction with a local language model and keeps rules as the default after measuring model regression.

projects.title: RAG Evaluation Platform
projects.description: A reproducible comparison of sparse, dense, hybrid, and reranked retrieval, with confidence intervals and regression gates to make quality changes measurable.
projects.detail: Evaluations across SciFact, NFCorpus, and FiQA show that the best retrieval strategy changes with the domain. The pipeline connects versioned inputs, cited answers, evaluation reports, and observability.

projects.title: Real-Time ML Platform
projects.description: NYC taxi-duration modeling with validated data, point-in-time features, guarded model promotion, and online prediction serving on Kubernetes.
projects.detail: Combines batch training with MLflow model management and FastAPI serving. Includes local load and broker-recovery experiments with documented limits; the model uses completed-trip distance and is not a pre-trip ETA estimator.

projects.title: Secure Agent Platform
projects.description: An architecture plan for a workplace-agent lab with application-enforced permissions, reviewable actions, and reproducible prompt-injection evaluations.
projects.detail: The public repository currently contains the architecture and implementation plan. It proposes a phased study of legitimate task completion and attack resistance, beginning with structured generation, a frozen task suite, and one tool execution boundary.

projects.title: Deep Research
projects.description: A research backend that takes a question through an approved plan, parallel investigations, evidence review, and a cited report.
projects.detail: Application code owns budgets, tool access, recovery, and report validation. Published development examples show quick briefs, broader comparisons, and technical research with recorded evidence and cost.
